title: 76 Papers Accepted for NeurIPS 2026
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Researchers affiliated with RIKEN AIP had 76 papers accepted at NeurIPS 2026. The Neural Information Processing Systems Conference (NeurIPS) is one of the premier international conferences in machine learning and artificial intelligence. There were 30,709 valid paper submissions with a PDF to the NeurIPS Main Track this year, of which the program committee accepted 7,900* (25.7%) papers in total.
